actual: The remote github/codeql-action archive can stall before any workflow step starts, and its init Node process can then hold a GitHub HTTPS connection until the 30-minute job timeout. A 5-minute init step timeout did not cover ActionManager downloads; PR #3847 and #3848 remained queued behind the stuck job.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: CodeQL used a verified local CLI bundle but still downloaded github/codeql-action source for every job. Real runs stalled both while downloading that action archive and inside its init Node process, outside or beyond a useful step timeout, monopolizing the single Windows runner.
evidence_uris: runner worker log lines 4300-4735 and live process/socket evidence on 2026-08-27
expected: CodeQL must remain fail-closed while using the already verified local CLI directly for database creation, analysis, and authenticated SARIF upload. The workflow must not download github/codeql-action, and the direct analysis step must have a bounded timeout enforced by contract tests.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
reproduce_command: Inspect F:/Dev/github-actions-runner/aistock/_diag/Worker_20260827-114726-utc.log and Get-NetTCPConnection -OwningProcess 9832 during main CodeQL run for merge 7933ba59
